## Machine Learning & Computer Science Research Papers

### 1. Can Synthetic Data Replace Real Data? Evaluating the Efficacy, Limits, and Label Trustworthiness of Generative Data in Supervised Learning
- **Conference/Venue**: EFAST 2026 (Accepted)
- **Authors**: Niyaz Ahmad Khan, Yousuf Bin Nazib, Golam M Naeem, Eshrath Jahan Esha, Islam Uddin, Abu Ubayda
- **Abstract & Findings**: Evaluates CTGAN-generated tabular synthetic data using a medical dataset of 110,527 records with 4:1 class imbalance. Discovers non-linear degradation curves and defines synthetic label corruption. Introduces the **Synthetic Label Trustworthiness Estimation (SLTE)** framework, incorporating KNN label correction and confidence routing to narrow performance gaps in tabular machine learning models.
- **Keywords**: Synthetic Data, Generative AI, Tabular Learning, CTGAN, SLTE Framework, Label Corruption, Supervised Machine Learning.

### 2. The Impact of Social Media Use on Student Productivity: A Behavioral Economics Perspective
- **Conference/Venue**: NICSDG-2026 (Abstract Accepted)
- **Authors**: Niyaz Ahmad Khan, Yousuf Bin Nazib, Shahriar Najim
- **Abstract & Findings**: Applies behavioral economics constructs (nudge theory, present bias) to evaluate screen time and notification frequency across 6,000 student profiles. Identifies notification-driven attention disruption and self-control failure as major determinants of academic productivity loss.
- **Keywords**: Behavioral Economics, Nudge Theory, Cognitive Load, Student Productivity, Digital Well-being.

### 3. Student Performance Prediction Using Machine Learning
- **Venue**: Metropolitan University (AI Course Thesis, 2025)
- **Authors**: Niyaz Ahmad Khan, Eshrath Jahan Esha
- **Abstract & Findings**: Evaluates supervised machine learning algorithms to predict student final exam outcomes based on demographic and academic engagement variables across 708 students. Identifies past exam performance and attendance as primary predictors.
- **Keywords**: Machine Learning, Predictive Modeling, Educational Technology, Student Success Prediction.

## Highlighted Software Projects

### 1. CampusBite (Canteen Pre-Order & Queue Management Platform)
- **Stack**: Vue.js, Node.js, Express, MySQL, UptimeRobot API
- **Description**: Full-stack web platform designed to eliminate university canteen queue congestion through real-time order scheduling, live kitchen dashboards, and automated stock forecasting.

### 2. HealthBridge (Unified Healthcare & Donor Portal)
- **Stack**: HTML, CSS, PHP, MySQL
- **Description**: Database-centric medical web ecosystem facilitating real-time blood donor geolocation searches, doctor appointment scheduling, and pharmacy stock management with normalized SQL query optimization.

### 3. Parlor Management System (Desktop Salon Software)
- **Stack**: Java, Java Swing, MySQL
- **Description**: Desktop software featuring a custom dark-themed Swing UI, customer treatment suggestions based on historical data, revenue analytics charts, and offline database synchronization.

### 4. Personal Portfolio Website
- **Stack**: Vue.js 3, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Three.js / TresJS
- **Description**: High-performance interactive portfolio featuring custom scroll-spy navigation, glassmorphism aesthetics, scroll-reveal animation engine, interactive vector kitten companion, and AI assistant query engine.
